comment: Nothing in the module reads the grid input, the sixteen tap level inputs, or the two phase reverse inputs; all nineteen are configured and drawn, and no line of process() touches them. The mute, stack, ping pong and reverse inputs have no fixed threshold: with the matching trigger mode switch on gate they are read above 0V, and on trigger they go through a Schmitt trigger at 1V.
